metadata.title: Complete Family Tree of Fredric Muller Vollmer
metadata.scope: Canonical Vollmer tree plus Arianna Lynn Fischer and her documented direct paternal and maternal ancestry; no Fischer collateral relatives were added.
metadata.privacy: Living addresses and contact information are omitted. Living exact dates are withheld except Arianna's owner-supplied birth year.

media_audit.policy: Use only verified person images; preserve living-person privacy; retain external or rights-restricted photos as links rather than copied files; attach evidence through explicit person mappings and retain exclusions as controls.

corrections.prior: Earlier edition treated Gwen’s household as secondary/provisional.
corrections.corrected: Gwen is displayed as one of the four children of Charles II and Eloise, coequal with Anne, Philip and Charles.

corrections.prior: Earlier edition used broad family-email grouping.
corrections.corrected: Carey’s direct statement that she is Jim’s one and only daughter, plus the Gwen/Jim/Mark family letter, supports Carey and Mark as the two children.
The chart name is James Chaffee. Janet is removed everywhere.

corrections.prior: Earlier narrative risked calling Jan’s cousins Fredric’s first cousins.
corrections.corrected: They are Fredric’s first cousins once removed. Fredric has no identified maternal first cousins through Bruce in the reviewed evidence.

corrections.prior: Earlier wording could be read as saying Bruce or Charles had no children.
corrections.corrected: Now says “no children identified/located,” explicitly distinguishing absence of evidence from evidence of absence.

corrections.prior: Earlier extension discovered and inferred relationships mainly through email frequency and recipient lists.
corrections.corrected: Households are reconstructed from parent couples downward; the 1998 chart, public records and direct statements outrank recipient-list inference.

corrections.prior: Earlier scope was not explicit enough.
corrections.corrected: Includes Fredric’s immediate maternal collateral family and Jan’s aunts/uncles and first cousins on both parental branches. Descendants of Jan’s cousins are excluded.
Jan is Fredric's biological mother and Chris Vollmer's stepmother.
Owner-confirmed: Henry Richard Vollmer and Mary Alice Thoren are Chris Vollmer's biological parents; Chris is Fredric's paternal half-brother. This supersedes the earlier unconfirmed-father status.
Owner-confirmed as Mary Alice Thoren, born in Port Townsend, Washington.
The 1950 census identifies William J. Thoren and Alice Gallaher Thoren as Mary Alice's parents.
A record chain identifies William John Thoren's parents as Christian Andrew Thoren and Augusta Nilsdotter, then extends their Swedish direct ancestry through named eighteenth-century ancestors.
Alice Gallaher's parents remain unproved. The unsourced James M. Gallaher and Agnes Cope member-tree hint is retained only as a rejected/unverified lead.
Nils's 1825 baptism names only his mother, Gunnilla Nilsdotter; no father is inferred from the Svensson patronymic.
Henry R. Vollmer married Mary A. Thoren in King County on 16 Sep 1955, before Jan Muller Vollmer.
Historical records identify Elmer James Chaffee Jr; the family chart's James form is retained as a shorter usage.
Official California index supports 25 Aug 1903-10 Feb 1994; earlier compiled dates remain conflicting secondary evidence.
Owner-confirmed spelling is Charles Frederic Vollmer; Frederick is retained only as a record/index variant.
Town-history and monument evidence support 13 Apr 1765; the copied 1785 member-tree date is rejected.
Will and probate evidence establish a death between 11 Feb 1653/54 and 4 Apr 1654; 4 Apr 1655 is rejected.
Ancestry's existing-tree hint supplies 15 Jun 1958-4 Jun 1972; owner testimony places the death at a Vancouver hospital and remembers age 14. The calculated-age discrepancy is retained.

Duplicate Peter/Pete profiles were consolidated as Peter Vollmer, 29 Jun 1959-5 Aug 1975. The obituary index names Henry R Vollmer as father and Christopher as sibling; Peter's mother remains unconfirmed.
Owner supplied Ray W. Fischer; Ohio records repeatedly identify him as Wallace Ray Fischer. The record form is used with the owner's form retained as an alias note.

The owner identified Wallace Ray Fischer's parents. Texas marriage, census, and 2022 death records support Raymond Charles Fischer Jr. and Wanda June Wallace Fischer; the prior blank-parent stopping point is superseded.
Wanda and June are one person: official Texas marriage records use Wanda J. Wallace and the newspaper marriage index expands her name to Wanda June Wallace. A 2022 tribute addresses her as June.

Owner correction, 5 September 2026: Annie is Arianna Lynn Fischer, Fredric Muller Vollmer’s wife. I175 was an erroneous duplicate with an incorrect Vollmer surname and sister/child relationship; it is retired. Retain I356, her documented Fischer parents, and spouse family F156.
